title: Anukret on the appointment of the composition of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia
text:

KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA
Royal Government of Cambodia
No: 396 ANKR.TT NATION RELIGION KING
ANUKRET
ON
THE APPOINTMENT OF THE COMPOSITION OF
THE SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION OF CAMBODIA
3
The Royal Government of Cambodia
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kret No. NS/RKT/0908/1055 on 25 September 2008 on the
Appointment of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. 02/NS/94 on 20 July 1994 promulgating the Law
on the Organization and Functioning of the Council of Ministers;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/18 on 24 January 1996
promulgating the Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Economy and Finance;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/1007/028 on 19 October 2007
promulgating the Law on the Issuance and Trading of Non-Government Securities;
- Having seen Anuket No. 97/ANKR.BK on 23 July 2008 on the Conduct and Organization
of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kret No. NS/RTT/0708/928 on 30 July 2008 on the
Appointment of Director General and Deputy Directors General of the Securities and
Exchange Commission of Cambodia;
- Referring to the proposal of the Minister of Economy and Finance;
1

noitalsnarT
laiciffonU
Decided
Article 1. -
Having been appointed the composition of the Securities and Exchange Commission of
Cambodia (SECC) as following:
1- H.E. Mr. KEAT Chhon Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of
Economy and Finance Chairman
2- H.E. Dr. AUN Porn Moniroth Secretary of State of the Ministry of
Economy and Finance Member
3- H.E. Mrs. NEAV Chanthana Deputy Governor of the National Bank of
Cambodia Member
4- H.E. Mr. KAN Channmeta Under Secretary of State of Ministry of
Commerce Member
5- H.E. Mr. KOEUT Rith Under Secretary of State of Ministry of
Justice Member
6- H.E. Mr. KEM Reat Viseth Advisor to Deputy Prime Minister and
the Minister of Council Ministers Member
7- H.E. MING Bankosal Director General of the Securities and
Exchange Commission of Cambodia Member
8- Dr. SAM Ghanty Private Expert Member
9- Dr. SAM Sokhom Private Expert Member
Article 2. –
The Minister of Council of Ministers, the Minister of Economy and Finance and as the
Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia, the Governor of the
National Bank of Cambodia, the Minister of Commerce, the Minister of Justice, Ministers,
Secretaries of State of all relevant institutions and Person-concerned shall implement this
Anukret after the date of signing.
Phnom Penh, March 18, 2009
Prime Minister
(Signature and Seal)
SAMDECH AKAK MOHA SENA PADEI TECHO HUN SEN
